nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty birthday dining room: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is the son's wife's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone and hair. Image 3 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 4 shows the boy's clothes: use it only for his sleeves. Wide shot. The photo shows the whole birthday table frozen: the son's wife stares at her plate, the granddaughter covers her mouth with her hand, at the right edge of the frame the boy's small hand and striped sleeve rest on the table, his face out of the frame; two older Black American relatives sit frozen, soft at the far end; gold balloons float behind them. The son's wife: a 44-year-old Black American woman with light-medium brown skin and natural hair in a neat high bun. She wears nice dinner clothes. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a plain grey hoodie with no logo and leggings. The son's youngest child, a 10-year-old Black American boy with medium-deep brown skin: only his small hands and forearms appear, at the edge of the table; his face stays out of the frame. His sleeves belong to a striped polo shirt. Other dishes on the table, soft: collard greens, candied sweet potatoes and cornbread. The granddaughter's own water bottle stands on the table at the far side of her place, away from her plate and her hands, and nobody touches it: a large light-pink insulated tumbler with a handle, a lid and a straw, plain, with no logo or lettering. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: the son's wife is the same woman as in her character sheet; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids. No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays; the banner lettering in the background stays.
